{{short description|French mathematician}}
[[File:Gilles Lebeau.jpg|thumb|Gilles Lebeau]]

'''Gilles Lebeau''' is a [[:Category:French mathematicians|French mathematician]] born on 17 November 1954, professor at the [[University of Nice Sophia Antipolis|University of Nice Sophia-Antipolis]] (since 2001),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://math.unice.fr/laboratoire/fiche&id=224|title=Université de Nice|date=}}</ref> member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France|Institut universitaire de France]] (since 2003)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/566-gilles-lebeau.html|title=IUF|date=}}</ref> and member of the [[French Academy of Sciences|Académie des sciences]] (since 2005).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-L/gilles-lebeau.html|title=Académie des sciences|date=}}</ref>

== School career and teaching ==
Gilles Lebeau is a former student of the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]] (ENS) de la rue d'Ulm (class of S1974). Lebeau studied from 1974 to 1978 at the ENS with ''[[agrégation]]'' in 1976. There he graduated in 1978 with ''Thèse de troisième cycle'' and in 1983 with ''Thèse d'État'' under the supervision of [[Louis Boutet de Monvel]]. Lebeau has been a professor at the University of Orsay and at the [[École Polytechnique]].

== Scientific awards and honours ==

* BM France Award (1988)
* Invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Kyoto (1990)<ref>{{cite book|author=Lebeau, Gilles|chapter=Interaction des Singularités Faibles pour les Équations d'Ondes Semi-linéaires|pages=1155–1164|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, August 21–29, 1990, Kyoto|volume=II|url=https://www.mathunion.org/fileadmin/ICM/Proceedings/ICM1990.2/ICM1990.2.ocr.pdf}}</ref>
* Silver medal of the [[CNRS]] (1992)<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.polytechnique.edu/accueil/l-ecole-polytechnique/prix-et-distinctions/gilles-lebeau-prix-8763.kjsp |title=Prix et distinctions - École Polytechnique |access-date=2019-09-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140114163857/http://www.polytechnique.edu/accueil/l-ecole-polytechnique/prix-et-distinctions/gilles-lebeau-prix-8763.kjsp |archive-date=2014-01-14 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Servant Prize of the [[Academy of Sciences]] (1992)
* Junior member of the Institut universitaire de France (1992–1997)
* [[Ampère Prize]] (Grand Prize of the Academy of Sciences) (2003)
